# Languages 4

> > Languages 4 is an Indigenous language learning platform powered by advanced speech recognition and Scaffolded Immersion pedagogy to support language reclamation and sovereignty.

Languages 4 combines cutting-edge educational technology with Indigenous language revitalization, offering communities tools for language preservation and cultural continuity. The platform serves Indigenous nations including Wahta Mohawks, Chickasaw, and Navajo through immersive, community-centered learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous language reclamation
- Language sovereignty
- Scaffolded Immersion™
- Speech recognition technology
- Language revitalization
- Cultural preservation
- Immersive learning
- Educational technology
- Indigenous communities
- Language learning platform
- Community curriculum
- 3D sound articulation modeling
- Augmented reality
- Gamification
- Virtual education
